description:
Because:
- We want to implement the new and improved pairing v2 flows:
  - We want to support the new v2 QR format
  - We want to support navite camera scanning
  - We want to adhere to new figma designs.

This Commit:
- Ensures the /pair page sends users into the pairing v2 flows when appropriate.
- Uses the new `/Pair2/*` components
- Creates container components to handle pairing state changes and subsequent navigations.
- Updates pairing integrations to handle the pairing channel events.
- Enforces the correct integration is provdided per pairing component.
- Fixes in firefox promo banner. The redirect to pair must force a new integration be created.
